samples.summary: Text-box collapsed-caret font-size step: new raw-base / effective-size split has no test that can distinguish it
samples.evidence: `stepSelectionFontSize`'s no-selection branch was rewritten to read the *current* size from `caretStyle(true)` (named-style defaults layered in) while storing a *raw* `base` from `caretStyle(false)`. The only collapsed-caret step test is packages/docs/test/view/text-box-editor.test.ts:786, which uses a plain `paragraph` block whose run already carries `fontSize: 11` — raw and effective are identical there, so it passes with the old code too. The new describe block added by this diff (text-box-editor.test.ts:936-956, 'steps the font size from the named-style default') calls `selectAll()` first, exercising the *range* branch (`visitStyledRunsInRange`), not the collapsed-caret branch. Nothing asserts (a) a heading-6/heading-1 collapsed caret steps from 20 rather than the 11pt fallback, nor (b) the stated invariant that the staged pending style stays raw (no baked `fontSize`/`italic`/`color` from the named style) — the docs editor got that invariant test (backward-selection-toggle.test.ts:345) but the text box did not.

samples.summary: New clamping of a stale/out-of-range cell rectangle in visitCellRectangleSlices is untested
samples.evidence: `visitCellRectangleSlices` adds defensive clamping absent from the code it replaces (`Math.max(0, ...)` on min row/col, `Math.min(rows.length - 1, ...)` and a max-cells-per-row clamp on the maxima). Every cell-rectangle test added (backward-selection-toggle.test.ts:615, :638, :798, :811) uses an in-bounds 1x2 rectangle over a well-formed table, and no test passes a negative index, a row index past `rows.length`, or a column index past the widest row. There is no unit-test file for model/range-slices.ts at all (packages/docs/test/model contains no range-slices/range-runs/caret-style test), so this new branch is only covered by paths where the clamps are no-ops.

samples.summary: Text-box multi-block range reads switched traversal (doc.document.blocks -> shared getContextBlocks/blockParentMap walk) with no multi-block text-box test
samples.evidence: Both `stepSelectionFontSize` and `getRangeStyleSummary` in text-box-editor.ts previously walked `doc.document.blocks` by index; they now go through `visitStyledRunsInRange` -> `visitRangeSlices`, which uses `doc.blockParentMap` and `doc.getContextBlocks()`. Every text-box test constructs the editor with either `blocks: []` or a single block (packages/docs/test/view/text-box-editor.test.ts lines 60, 86, 108, 148, 182, 237, 266, 407, 557, 587, 616, 718, 753, 805, 889, 951), so a cross-block selection inside a text box — the case whose traversal actually changed — is never exercised.

samples.summary: New focus-side fallback in applyStyleToSelection's dirty-marking has no test
samples.evidence: `applyStyleToSelection` changed the cell-internal dirty-mark lookup from `getCellInfo(range.anchor.blockId)` to `getCellInfo(anchor) ?? getCellInfo(focus)` — i.e. it now marks the parent table dirty when only the *focus* endpoint lives in a cell. No test in packages/docs/test/view (including the new backward-selection-toggle.test.ts) asserts anything about markDirty/render invalidation for that shape; all new tests assert stored style only, which is unaffected by dirty-marking. A regression here (stale painted cell) would pass CI silently.

verdict.reason: The collapsed-caret branch in packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:869-887 reads the stepped-from size from the effective style (caretStyle(true)) while staging a raw base (caretStyle(false)). Repo-wide, only three test call sites hit stepSelectionFontSize on a text box. text-box-editor.test.ts:811/814 uses a paragraph run that already carries fontSize: 11 (line 793), so raw == effective and the assertions (12, 13) pass under either read — the test cannot distinguish the split, and it never inspects the staged style's contents. text-box-editor.test.ts:954 first calls selectAll (line 953), which I confirmed sets a real range (text-editor.ts:858-862 -> selectAll() at :2811-2819 calls selection.setRange), so it exercises the range branch (visitStyledRunsInRange, text-box-editor.ts:896), not the caret branch. All other stepSelectionFontSize occurrences in tests are stubs/mocks (slides + frontend). The docs editor's collapsed-caret path is a separate implementation (editor.ts:1072-1084), so its tests do not cover this branch. No test asserts (a) a heading collapsed caret steps from the named-style default rather than the 11pt fallback, nor (b) that the staged pending style stays raw. That is a changed behavior in-lane for the test-adequacy rubric with no test that can fail if it regresses.
